providers.name: LemAstra Calculation Service
providers.retention: Ephemeral, compute-and-discard — the request payload (birth data, place query, coordinates, timezone) is discarded immediately after the response is returned; charts persist device-side only in v1, never server-side (retention-deletion-policy.md §1)

providers.name: Google Geocoding + Time Zone APIs (server-side)
providers.retention: Ephemeral server-proxy handling — discarded after response (retention-deletion-policy.md §1); Google request-data terms re-verified when Phase 2 wires it (research A4)
providers.notes: Re-verify Google request-data terms (caching/attribution constraints) when the flow is wired (research A4).

providers.name: LemAstra Hosting Provider (server logs)
providers.transmissionTrigger: Every API request the calculation service handles (Phase 2)
providers.retention: Server logs bounded to 14 days, access-restricted to the operator; redaction rule excludes birth data, chart payloads, user questions, and generated prose from logged content (retention-deletion-policy.md §2)

providers.name: OpenAI Responses API (managed connection)
providers.retention: Placeholder — not authorized to activate until provider retention controls are re-verified; research A2 records ≈30-day default application-state retention unless store:false/zero-data-retention (retention-deletion-policy.md §3)
providers.notes: Retention specifics re-verified at Phase 7 before this provider flips to active (research A2).

providers.name: Supabase (auth/sync infrastructure)
providers.transmissionTrigger: None in v1 (planned: account sign-in and sync, post-v1)
providers.retention: Not applicable in v1 — activation ships with its own retention decisions and updates this registry (retention-deletion-policy.md §7)
providers.notes: Post-v1 account/sync provider; publishable key only in the client when enabled — never a service-role key.

providers.name: Sentry diagnostics (optional)
providers.transmissionTrigger: None by default; opt-in crash/diagnostic report if activated post-beta
providers.retention: Excluded by default — no telemetry ships while the default posture holds; activation is opt-in, post-beta, and scrubbing-gated via beforeSend (retention-deletion-policy.md §4)
providers.notes: Opt-in, post-beta; scrubbing preconditions per retention-deletion-policy.md §4 (birth data, chart payloads, questions, and prose are never transmitted).
